title: Floren
summary: FLOR'EN FLOR'ENCE, noun An ancient gold coin of Edward III of six shillings sterling value, about 134 cents. FLOR'ENCE, noun 1. A kind of cloth. 2. A kind of wine from Florence in Italy.
